summary: Prioritizing name matches over description matches
text: Reworked AI exhibitor search so exact partner name matches outrank coordinators that merely mention the term in their description, ensuring buyers at IMEX land on the right company. Introduced hybrid name-priority scoring on top of semantic search so name-field matches always score above description-level hits across exhibitor entities.

summary: No alias or multi-lingual variant handling
text: Added cultural-name and diacritic tolerance to AI search so endonym/exonym variants (e.g. 'Italia' for 'Italy') return the right exhibitors. Combined semantic similarity with ascii_folding character normalisation so common language variants and diacritic differences surface relevant results instead of zero results.

Name matches not prioritized in autocomplete suggestion results
text: Search autocomplete now prioritises name matches over description matches, so attendees see the most relevant entity at the top of suggestion results. Autocomplete ranking was changed so name matches are prioritised over description matches across and within entity types.

summary: Overlenient substring matching pulling in noise
text: Routed partial-name typeahead through a dedicated fast autocomplete endpoint so over-lenient substring matching no longer floods AI search with noise. Added a separate prefix-indexed /autocomplete endpoint (~50ms) that keeps noisy substring behaviour out of full search and surfaces clean name suggestions.

summary: Spaces and special characters breaking name matches
text: Made AI search resilient to spacing and special-character differences so a query like 'Visit Scotland' still finds 'VisitScotland'. Tokeniser handling was fixed so spaced and unspaced/concatenated brand-name variants resolve to the correct exhibitor in top results.

summary: Coordinator/partner ranking hierarchy
text: Encoded the coordinator/partner hierarchy into AI search so exhibitor results follow a consistent parent/child ranking order. Extracted the parent/child relationship from PostgreSQL into the Qdrant payload during ingestion, enabling coordinator-exact, partner-exact, coordinator-fuzzy, partner-fuzzy ordering.

summary: Weak recovery states/dead ends
text: Replaced empty AI-search dead-ends with helpful 'Did you mean...?' and category fallback prompts so buyers always have a next step. Added fallback handling so a no-results query surfaces a no-results message with 'Did you mean...?' suggestions and category prompts rather than an empty page.

summary: IMEX demo CR
text: Tuned the AI search prototype ahead of the IMEX demo so 'did you mean' suggestions, gibberish handling and result counts behaved correctly, protecting a high-visibility client showcase. Suggestion logic, no-match handling and result-count display were corrected for the demo build.
